Allah asks a question to wake us up: what are people asking each other about?
They are asking about the great news. This is the big event that is coming, the Day of Judgment.
People argue about it. Some believe it is true and some do not.
Allah says: No! They will soon know the truth.
He says it again to make it stronger: they will surely know.
Allah made the earth like a comfortable bed so that we can live on it.
He made the mountains like pegs that keep the earth steady.
He created you in pairs, male and female.
He made your sleep a time of rest for your body.
He made the night like a cover, so you can rest in the darkness.
He made the day a time to work and earn your living.
He built seven strong skies above you.
He placed a bright, burning lamp in the sky. This is the sun.
He sends down heavy rain from the clouds.
With that rain He makes grain and plants grow.
And thick gardens full of trees.
The Day of Judgment is a fixed time. It will come exactly when Allah has decided.
That is the day the Trumpet is blown and you will all come out in large groups.
The sky will be opened up and will look like many doors.
The mountains will be moved and will look like a mirage, like something that is not really there.
Hell has been waiting.
It is the place for people who went past all limits and did wrong.
They will stay there for a very long time.
They will not taste anything cool or any drink there.
They will only have boiling water and a dirty, bad liquid.
This is a fair payment for what they did.
They never expected to be asked about their actions.
They strongly rejected Our verses.
But We have counted and written down everything.
They will be told: Taste it! We will only give you more punishment.
But for those who were mindful of Allah, there is success.
They will have gardens and grapevines.
And companions who are the same age as them.
And a full cup to drink from.
There they will not hear any bad talk or lies.
This is a reward and a generous gift from your Lord, given exactly as they earned it.
He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them, the Most Merciful. No one can speak to Him unless He allows it.
On that Day Jibril and the angels will stand in rows. No one will speak except the one Allah allows, and he will only say what is right.
That is the True Day. So whoever wants should make a way back to his Lord by doing good.
Allah has warned you of a punishment that is near. On that Day a person will see everything he sent ahead, and the one who rejected will say: I wish I were just dust!
